people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

translations.web: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.
translations.bsb: And for fear of Abner, Ish-bosheth did not dare to say another word to him.
translations.kjv: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
translations.asv: And he could not answer Abner another word, because he feared him.
